drivingQuestion: Until when may the morning Shema be recited — is the halakha like R' Yehoshua?
outcomeNote: the halakha is decided in accordance with R' Yehoshua's three-hour limit; nothing is contested in this unit.

segments.he: רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ אוֹמֵר עַד שָׁלֹשׁ שָׁעוֹת. אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna that «Rabbi Yehoshua says:» One may recite the morning Shema «until three hours» of the day. «Rav Yehuda said» that «Shmuel said: The halakha is in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabbi Yehoshua.»
